title.description: Human readable title for the custom ability

name.description: Unique name for the custom ability

description.description: Human readable description of this custom ability

introduced_by_issue.description: URL to GitLab issue that added this custom ability

introduced_by_mr.description: URL to GitLab merge request that added this custom ability

feature_category.description: The feature category of this this custom ability. For example, vulnerability_management

milestone.description: Milestone that introduced this custom ability. For example, 15.8

group_ability.description: Indicate whether this ability is checked on group level.

enabled_for_group_access_levels.description: Specifies group access levels where the custom ability is enabled by default

project_ability.description: Indicate whether this ability is checked on project level.

enabled_for_project_access_levels.description: Specifies project access levels where the custom ability is enabled by default

requirements.description: The custom abilities that need to be enabled for this ability.

group_permissions.description: The raw permissions that get enabled by this ability for a group.

project_permissions.description: The raw permissions that get enabled by this ability for a project.

skip_seat_consumption.description: Indicate wheter this ability should be skiped when counting licensed users

wip.description: When true, the ability is excluded from loaded definitions unless the GITLAB_LOAD_WIP_CUSTOM_ABILITIES env var is set. Used while the ability is in development. Remove the key when ready to ship.
